meta.title: WoW Forever Hunter pets and Warlock demons, levels 1-60

status_legend.forever: Forever client data, or a wowsims-forever value read in the Forever game

sources.ES: Forever client DB2 ExpectedStat (ContentSetID 0), build 1.60.1.70862, wago.tools CSV (ext/wago/ExpectedStat_70862.csv)
sources.WS_HPET: wowsims-forever sim/hunter/pets.go: a tamed pet's own health and armor are the creature values for its level (ExpectedStat), its own attack power is 30% of the creature dps as attack power (x14), i.e. floor(4.2 x creature dps): 'on the sheets of a level 11 Carrion Bird, a level 17 Cat and a level 30 pet' 36, 61, 103. Swing 2.0 s, average (creature dps - AP/14) x 2, +-20%. Happiness x1.25 damage.
sources.WS_DEMON: wowsims-forever sim/warlock/pets.go petModels: health and armor are fixed shares of the creature values for the demon's level ('The shares are read at levels 20 and 30 (the Voidwalker's at 30 only), not yet at 60'); attributes, mana and conversions are level 60 values from 'the team's pet model sheet'.
sources.CM_PET: cmangos classic-db pet_levelstats (vanilla 1.12): creature_entry 1 = hunter pets, 416 Imp, 1860 Voidwalker, 1863 Succubus, 417 Felhunter
sources.CM_FAM: cmangos classic-db pet_familystats. Column order caution: the table's columns are named (healthModifier, damageModifier, armorModifier), but the values match the vanilla family modifiers as (health, armor, damage) (e.g. Cat 0.98/1.00/1.10, Bear 1.08/1.05/0.91, Boar 1.04/1.09/0.90); read here as health, armor, damage.

meta.layout: hunter.levels[] / warlock.<demon>.levels[] indexed by level-1; entries {level, value, status, source}. Ability families use the <class>_ranks.json rank schema.
forever_changes: Hunter pets: 'Pets now get increased stats based on their Hunter's gear' and 'can no longer receive player stat buffs'; every family can learn Bite or Claw and Dive or Dash plus one unique ability; Foxes are new (Trickster's Dance) (Blizzard Hunter & Druid deep dive).
Hunter pets keep their attack speed passives when untrained (kami-labs, 2 Nov notes).
Warlock demons scale from the warlock's stats (Rogue & Warlock deep dive, Warcraft Tavern 7 Oct); 2 Nov notes: demons get 2 health per point of the warlock's Stamina (was 7.5).
Warlock: training costs reduced by what the pets' Grimoires would cost (kami-labs 2 Nov), i.e. demon abilities still come from Grimoires.
gaps: Hunter pet health below and at 60: wowsims keeps the creature health (one in-game reading); the share of the owner's Stamina is unread (wowsims uses 2 per point, TODO).
Hunter pet attack power is measured at levels 11, 17 and 30 only; other levels follow the same rule (estimate).

Demon health/armor shares are read at levels 20 and 30 (Voidwalker at 30 only); other levels follow the shares (estimate). Demon attributes exist only at 60 in Forever data; per-level attributes are vanilla (cmangos).
Felhunter: no Forever health share; its health is 9.5 per point of its own Stamina, known only at 60.
Felguard (Demonology) and Incubus: not modelled by wowsims; no Forever numbers here.
Pet crit, hit and spell power inheritance shares are wowsims's (partly unverified, see the TODOs quoted).

model.base_stats_per_level: levels[] (health and armor = ExpectedStat creature values for the pet's level; AP = floor(4.2 x creature dps))

inheritance_from_hunter.health: 2 per point of the hunter's Stamina (wowsims TODO: unread)
inheritance_from_hunter.attack_power: 10% of the higher of the hunter's melee and ranged AP
inheritance_from_hunter.crit: the hunter's higher of melee/ranged crit (minus 0.04% per weapon skill point under max)
inheritance_from_hunter.hit: the hunter's ranged hit; spell hit = 17/8 of it
inheritance_from_hunter.when: snapshot on summon and on any pet action, at most every 2 s
